chunks: O people, fear your Lord and dread the day when no father will avail a son, nor son his father. Truly the promise of God is true. Do not be deluded by the life of this world, and do not let the deceiver draw you away from God.
ai.seo_question: What happens to family relationships on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Luqman?
ai.summary: This verse serves as a pivotal reminder of individual accountability on the Day of Resurrection, where the intercessory power of parents or children is nullified, underscoring the Shia emphasis on personal piety over social or familial status. It warns against the deceptive allure of worldly life (al-dunya) and the specific deceit of Satan (al-gharur), urging believers to maintain spiritual vigilance against both materialism and divine promise. The call to 'fear' (ikhsha) implies a deep, reverential awe that motivates consistent righteous action rather than mere superficial obedience.
